{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN (missing data)
df_clean['customer_age'] = df_clean['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Compute mean age of customers
mean_age = df_clean['customer_age'].mean(numeric_only=True)

# Print result
print(f"Mean customer age: {mean_age}")"}
